import copy, json, math
from work import evaluate

def check(name, request, policy, expected):
    r0=copy.deepcopy(request); p0=copy.deepcopy(policy)
    got=evaluate(request,policy)
    assert got==expected,(name,got,expected)
    assert request==r0,(name,'request mutated')
    assert policy==p0,(name,'policy mutated')
    assert set(got)=={'ok','records','errors'}
    for rec in got['records']: assert set(rec)=={'id','amount'}
    for err in got['errors']: assert set(err)=={'row','cause'}

p={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}
